name: Short 5 - three_operating_systems
script: Inside Nokia, teams were competing against each other instead of against Apple and Google. Different groups pushed different platforms. Symbian, then Maemo, then MeeGo. Managers were reportedly afraid to bring bad news upward, so leadership never heard how serious it had gotten. So Nokia kept announcing a new software plan, then replacing it, then announcing another one. And developers did the math. Why build apps for a platform that might not exist in eighteen months? The app gap wasn't a design failure. It was a trust failure.
